featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 更新并集中登记 68 个 Rust 库和 33 个前端包的兼容候选下界，同步中性资产、生成器与文档，并增加一致性门禁。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Update and centrally record compatible candidate minimums for 68 Rust crates and 33 frontend packages, synchronize neutral assets, generators and documentation, and add consistency checks.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 通用环境采用 Rust 1.95.0 与连续 Node.js 24.0.0 下界；Rust 门禁结合项目 Cargo MSRV，按较高下界检查和复探。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use Rust 1.95.0 and continuous Node.js 24.0.0 as generic environment minimums; combine the Rust minimum with each project's Cargo MSRV and verify against the higher requirement.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 统一 Tauri 与 GPUI 的完整窗口标题，复用权威版本与语言状态，并补齐标题合同及生成资产回归。
bugFixes.en-US: Unify complete window titles in Tauri and GPUI using authoritative version and language state, with title contract checks and generated-asset regression coverage.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 为 TypeScript 依赖明确声明兼容上界，校验真实前端清单，避免安装超出 typescript-eslint peer 范围的版本。
bugFixes.en-US: Declare an explicit compatible upper bound for TypeScript and validate actual frontend manifests to prevent installation beyond the typescript-eslint peer range.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正成功标准中的旧 Rust 下界表述，明确通用环境下界与中性模板 MSRV 1.98.1 的区别。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct the outdated Rust minimum in the success criteria and distinguish the generic environment minimum from the neutral template's MSRV of 1.98.1.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 将统一 UI 设计基座纳入受管标准，以 DESIGN.md 为导航，贯通初始化、日常实施和下游工程升级。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add the unified UI foundation to managed standards, using DESIGN.md for navigation across initialization, daily implementation and downstream Harness upgrades.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: Tauri 与 GPUI 中性模板集中消费展示 Token，统一亮暗主题、侧栏和支持页；强调色随主题主色变化。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Make Tauri and GPUI neutral templates consume centralized presentation tokens for light and dark themes, sidebars and support pages, with accents following the theme primary color.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 退役 taste 自动安装和旧视觉硬锁，保留框架交互、列表数据合同、历史记录与既有下游自有资产保护。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Retire automatic taste installation and old visual constraints while preserving framework interactions, list data contracts, historical records and protection of existing downstream-owned assets.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 升级候选严格核对设计基座完整字节并保护项目自有 DESIGN.md；修正主色色板索引类型、侧栏旧尺寸断言及 GPUI Token 文档路径。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate complete design-foundation bytes in upgrade candidates while protecting project-owned DESIGN.md; fix primary-palette index typing, the outdated sidebar-size assertion and the documented GPUI token path.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 拆分 GPUI 依赖兼容、性能和打包知识，并通过 GUI 工程索引按任务加载。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Separate GPUI dependency compatibility, performance and packaging guidance, with task-based routing through the GUI engineering index.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 GPUI Linux GNU x64/ARM64 deb、tar.gz 打包流程，补齐 macOS 身份、Windows NSIS、全局工具及最终资源核对。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add GPUI Linux GNU x64/ARM64 deb and tar.gz packaging workflows, plus macOS identity, Windows NSIS, global-tool and final-resource checks.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 Tauri Linux 原生同架构 deb/AppImage 本地试包流程，以及受限 Debian 包名规范化。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add native same-architecture Tauri Linux deb/AppImage local trial packaging and bounded Debian package-name normalization.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一新项目初始化的问句、选项、顺序、条件问题和确认摘要；保留合法答案，漏答不自动确认。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unify new-project initialization questions, options, ordering, conditional prompts and confirmation summaries; preserve valid answers and require explicit completion of missing answers.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 补齐 Linux 窗口、托盘、自启、系统依赖和软件中心集成知识，明确经验与已实现能力的边界。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Expand Linux window, tray, autostart, system-dependency and software-center guidance, distinguishing prior experience from implemented capabilities.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 精简 Skills 入口并按场景加载引用；提炼当前工程记忆，同时完整保留历史 ADR 与变更记录原文。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Slim skill entrypoints and load references by scenario; distill current engineering memory while preserving the complete original ADR and changelog history.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 GPUI 开发循环遇到 EPERM 等未知进程组状态时的异常逃逸和错误回收判断。
bugFixes.en-US: Handle unknown process-group states such as EPERM in the GPUI development loop without uncaught errors or false cleanup claims.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 发布审查范围摘要改为临时文件分块哈希，避免大体积二进制补丁超过输出缓冲上限。
bugFixes.en-US: Hash release-review diffs in chunks through a temporary file so large binary patches do not exceed subprocess output buffers.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Debian 必需运行库只接受独立直接依赖，避免备选依赖组被误判为保证安装。
bugFixes.en-US: Require standalone direct dependencies for mandatory Debian runtime libraries instead of treating alternative dependency groups as guaranteed installation.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Linux 候选在编译探测前核对当次 E2E 选择、发布上下文和干净源码；拒绝时保留旧候选。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate the current E2E choice, release context and clean source before Linux candidate compiler probes, preserving previous candidates on rejection.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 清理 Linux 交叉构建继承的 CC、CXX、AR 变量，防止高优先级目标变体覆盖已核验的工具链。
bugFixes.en-US: Clear inherited CC, CXX and AR variables in Linux cross builds so higher-priority target variants cannot override the verified toolchain.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 Linux 本地试包 Skill 的初始化保留与升级传播，并恢复下游文档剥离上游专用语言禁令的要求。
bugFixes.en-US: Retain and propagate the Linux local-packaging skill during initialization and upgrades, and restore removal of upstream-only language prohibitions from downstream documentation.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 左侧 Task 默认关闭，仅按项目明确选择开启；统一 Task 与工作树合同，已授权范围内自检通过即可继续执行。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Sidebar Tasks stay off by default and follow the project’s explicit choice; one Task and worktree contract lets authorized work continue after self-checks.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 独立工作树按文件所有权并行创建和执行，预留与登记使用短锁，同一 Local 工作区串行。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Independent worktrees are created and run in parallel by file ownership, with short locks for reservations and registration; one Local workspace remains serial.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 新下游离线安装项目本地的 GPUI Kit 开发与设计 Skills，保留固定上游快照、摘要和 Apache 许可，并在升级时保护本地副本。
featureOptimizations.en-US: New GPUI downstream projects install local GPUI Kit development and design Skills offline, preserving the pinned upstream snapshot, hashes and Apache license; upgrades protect local copies.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正初始化保留统一 Task 技能的说明，并清理治理检查器未使用的标题常量。
bugFixes.en-US: Corrected the initialization instructions for retaining the unified Task Skill and removed unused title constants from the governance validator.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增默认关闭的 Task 独立工作树开关，与 Task Tree 和内部并行分别选择；派发时冻结 Worktree 或串行 Local 环境。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add a default-off switch for independent Task worktrees, separate from Task Tree and internal parallelism; freeze the Worktree or serial Local environment at dispatch.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新初始化使用 schema 5 六项能力；严格读取旧 schema 3/4，仅在明确补选后受限迁移工作树选择并保留原确认事实。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use six capabilities in schema 5 for new projects; strictly read legacy schemas 3/4 and migrate the worktree choice only after explicit selection while preserving prior confirmation facts.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 初始化与升级完整保留独立工作树技能，升级继续保护项目策略、用户级规则和既有 Task 环境。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Retain the independent worktree skill during initialization and upgrades while protecting project policy, user-level rules, and existing Task environments.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复策略原子切换在 umask 影响下丢失原文件权限的问题；权限恢复失败时保留原文件并清理临时文件。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve original file permissions during atomic policy updates despite umask filtering; keep the original file and remove the temporary file if permission restoration fails.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 将初始化策略验收合同对齐到 schema 5 六项，并区分旧 schema 3/4 的读取兼容与受限迁移。
bugFixes.en-US: Align the initialization policy verification contract with schema 5 and six capabilities, distinguishing legacy schema 3/4 reading from restricted migration.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 优先执行已确认的用户长期硬规则，同时保留模板默认和既有项目策略。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Apply confirmed user rules before project preferences while preserving template defaults and existing policies.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 将 Task 真实项目、非置顶、独立 Worktree 与提交基线核对前移到业务阅读之前，并明确阶段隔离、原任务恢复与迁移证据。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Verify each Task identity, project, unpinned state, independent worktree and commit baseline before business reading, with explicit stage boundaries and evidence for recovery and handoff.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一初始化、开发与发布的中文提交说明，增加只读消息检查、暂存前校验和提交后真实消息复读。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use Chinese commit descriptions for initialization, development and releases, with read-only message checks, validation before staging and verification of the committed message.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 升级时完整传播中文提交校验依赖，并保护已有策略偏好、确认元数据和自定义正文。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Propagate the complete commit-validation dependency set during upgrades while protecting existing policy preferences, confirmation metadata and custom text.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 独立抽取 13 个能力与治理 Skills，按任务触发加载，并在初始化和升级时按框架保留或裁剪。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Extract 13 focused capability and governance Skills, loaded by task trigger and retained or pruned by framework during initialization and upgrades.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 永久能力策略使用共享锁、旧值核对与原子写入；更新日志预览提供独立只读入口。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Permanent capability preferences use a shared lock, expected-value checks and atomic writes; release-note previews have a dedicated read-only entrypoint.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复保留的升级测试引用下游已裁剪的上游专属清单。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix retained upgrade tests importing an upstream-only manifest that is pruned from downstream projects.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 策略测试使用独立确认夹具，兼容已初始化下游的能力选择和 LF/CRLF 换行，并保持真实策略字节不变。
bugFixes.en-US: Use independent policy test fixtures for initialized downstream preferences and LF/CRLF line endings while preserving the actual policy bytes.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 原生开发支持保存后自动重编译并重启，覆盖 Rust、Cargo、词典和静态资源；编译失败后继续监听，编译期间保存会追加构建。
featureOptimizations.en-US: GPUI native development now rebuilds and restarts automatically after Rust, Cargo, locale or static-resource changes; watching continues after compilation errors and saves during a build trigger another build.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 GPUI 根 package.json 的 pnpm dev 入口，新建、追加接口和显式迁移共用脚本合同，并拒绝覆盖冲突的产品脚本。
bugFixes.en-US: Add the missing pnpm dev script to GPUI root package.json; new workspaces, adapter additions and explicit migrations share the same contract and reject conflicting product scripts.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 首次启动及词典/资源变化时刷新所选 GUI 调试缓存，避免旧 build.rs 或过程宏复用过时资源；停止开发会话时清理所拥有的构建和应用进程。
bugFixes.en-US: Invalidate the selected GUI debug cache on first launch and locale/resource changes to avoid stale build-script or procedural-macro resources; clean up owned build and application processes when the development session stops.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 发布后动作、版本、Task 序号和 Core-first 规则收敛为单一权威来源，其余文档只保留指针，并精简 AGENTS.md。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Consolidate post-release, version, task-numbering and core-first rules into single authoritative sources with pointers elsewhere, and slim AGENTS.md.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 原生能力补全路由：Tauri 专用 Skill 标明适用范围，设计标准索引与 GUI 路由行指向 GPUI 能力参考，并明确 GPUI 窗口检查的归属。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Complete GPUI routing: mark Tauri-only skills, point the design-standards index and GUI routing row to the GPUI capability references, and name the GPUI window-check owner.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Rust 模板中过期的 Agent Policy schema v3 引用，并清理已关闭的技术债条目和历史叙述。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix the stale Agent Policy schema v3 reference in the Rust template and remove closed tech-debt entries and historical narration.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 GPUI 原生桌面初始化，提供双语身份、三态主题、系统语言、受限窗口恢复和可选支持页。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add GPUI desktop initialization with bilingual identity, three-state themes, system locale, bounded window restoration, and optional support pages.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: GPUI 按选择接入托盘、通知、自启、单实例和全局快捷键；未启用能力不生成依赖或实现。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Generate optional GPUI tray, notifications, autostart, single-instance activation, and global shortcuts only when selected.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 GPUI 根 pnpm 工程命令，统一验证、Rust 测试、发布和原生打包入口，并安全合并已有配置。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add root pnpm commands for GPUI validation, Rust tests, release workflows, and native packaging, with safe configuration merging.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增独立 GPUI 打包流程和有界后台日志；初始化、升级与发布后动作按 GUI 框架路由。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add separate GPUI packaging and bounded background logging, with framework-aware initialization, upgrades, and post-release actions.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复详细侧栏折叠按钮的位置与点击区域，使其贴合侧栏边界和 Logo 中心。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix the detailed sidebar toggle position and hit area to align with the sidebar boundary and logo center.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复直接退出应用时可能丢失最新窗口位置和尺寸的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the latest window geometry when quitting the application directly.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 自启开关复读系统实际状态；未达到请求状态时明确反馈失败。
bugFixes.en-US: Report autostart changes as failed when the operating system readback does not match the requested state.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 在任何构建副作用前拒绝开启系统通知的未签名 macOS 候选。
bugFixes.en-US: Reject unsigned macOS candidates with system notifications enabled before any build side effects.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复合法引号框架键被误判为 Tauri，并拒绝重复、错位和表化配置。
bugFixes.en-US: Recognize valid quoted GUI framework keys and reject duplicate, misplaced, or table-shaped configuration.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 Windows 原生 ABI 声明文档，并实际验证生成工程的声明检查器。
bugFixes.en-US: Document Windows native ABI declarations and run the generated workspace through its retained declaration checker.
